text:
What if the future of software development isn’t about maintaining code, but regenerating it?

Dusan will take the stage at AI2FUTURE to explore this idea in his talk:

“AI code will be regenerated, not maintained”

📅 October 29, 9:30 - 10:00 
📍Zagreb, AI2FUTURE

He’ll share what we’re learning at *codeplain, where regenerative software approach already works and what this could mean for the future of software development.

If you’re attending the conference, you’re welcome to join the conversation!

Explore regenerative software idea here: https://lnkd.in/dp3GYGjB

#AI2Future #RegenerativeSoftware #AI #SoftwareDevelopment
